related_questions.question: How do I see how much taxes are on a property?
related_questions.title: The step-by-step process
list: The county tax assessor determines the value of each property in the area.
The local government sets the county tax rate (also known as the mill rate).
The mill rate is multiplied by your property's assessed value to calculate your property taxes.

related_questions.question: How to calculate property tax in Maine?
related_questions.snippet: Property taxes are levied according to a mill rate. The mill rate is the dollars / cents per $1,000 of value that you will pay in property taxes. For example, if you own a home valued at $100,000 and the tax rate is 20 mills, then your tax bill will be $2,000 (or $20 multiplied by 100).
